content.description: Illustration showing hands using calipers to measure clutch disc rivet head depth, with a detailed view of the rivet head and clutch disc friction material

items.title: INSPECT CLUTCH DISC FOR WEAR OR DAMAGE
items.content:
Using calipers, measure the rivet head depth.
Minimum rivet depth: 0.3 mm (0.012 in.)
If a problem is found, repair or replace the clutch disc.

content.description: Technical diagram showing clutch disc mounted on a dial indicator setup for measuring runout, with the disc positioned between two support stands

items.title: INSPECT CLUTCH DISC RUNOUT
items.content:
Using a dial indicator, check the disc runout.
Maximum runout: 0.8 mm (0.031 in.)
If runout is excessive, replace the disc.

content.description: Illustration of clutch flywheel with dial indicator positioned to measure flywheel runout, showing the internal clutch mechanism and measurement point

items.title: INSPECT FLYWHEEL RUNOUT
items.content:
Using a dial indicator, check the flywheel runout.
Maximum runout: 0.2 mm (0.008 in.)
If runout is excessive, repair or replace the flywheel.

content.description: Illustration showing a hand turning the pilot bearing while applying rotational force to inspect for smooth operation

items.title: INSPECT PILOT BEARING
items.content: Turn the bearing by hand while applying force in the rotating direction.

content.description: Illustration demonstrating the removal of pilot bearing using SST (Special Service Tool), showing hands using the tool against the flywheel

items.title: IF NECESSARY, REPLACE PILOT BEARING
items.content: (a) Using SST, remove the pilot bearing.
